Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: Relied on an erroneous search snippet and failed to open/verify authoritative sources for Charles Saunders’s birthdate. This created (and did not resolve) a disambiguation error, conflating entries and risking adoption of the incorrect 1946 DOB instead of the correct 1904 date—an error that would directly invert the comparison of which director was born later.
